item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00374","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C14","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12, issued only three days earlier, supplied a concrete component of the child’s broader government-wide resource-conservation directive. The child expressly incorporates the housing-credit restrictions as a policy “already in force” and extends the same defense-driven restraint to other federal credit programs. Both directives use the same factual predicate—recent international developments creating competing demand for materials needed for national defense—and the same machinery of agency reexamination, administrative tightening, interagency coordination, and reporting. C14 and C01 provide weaker parallels involving agency program review and central Executive Office or Bureau of the Budget oversight, but their objectives and operative details differ substantially.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Consistent with the restrictive policy already in force for housing credit, other credit programs should be tightened.","parent_excerpt":"I request that the Housing and Home Finance Agency and its constituent agencies take the following administrative actions","explanation":"The child explicitly identifies C12’s newly imposed housing-credit restrictions as the existing model and directs analogous tightening of other credit programs."},{"child_excerpt":"those projects which do not directly contribute to defense or to civilian requirements essential in the changed international situation","parent_excerpt":"as a result of events of the last month, many materials used in residential and other construction will be required in increasing amounts for national defense purposes","explanation":"Both directives predicate program restraint on the changed international situation and the need to reserve scarce materials for national defense."},{"child_excerpt":"Please reexamine your programs","parent_excerpt":"I request you to reexamine immediately the regulations of the Federal National Mortgage Association","explanation":"Both employ immediate administrative reexamination as the mechanism for curtailing resource-intensive civilian activity."},{"child_excerpt":"I am asking the Director of the Bureau of the Budget to work closely with you in this review and to report to me","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget has transmitted to me your recommendation","explanation":"Both place the Bureau of the Budget in a central oversight role, although this feature alone would be routine and is corroborative rather than decisive."}]}
